text:
lodash is bumped to 4.17.21 (from 4.17.15), but the tests don't pass: 3 fail in `src/utils/date-utils.spec.js` (DST boundary in America/New_York, local midnight parsing, month-end rollover in local tz).

I can't yet show these failures predate the bump. My `git stash` baseline isn't valid:
- `node_modules` isn't tracked, so stashing wouldn't have reverted the installed lodash. The second run likely still used 4.17.21.
- This directory isn't reported as a git repo, so the stash/pop may not have done anything. Check that `package.json` and the lockfile still show 4.17.21.

The failures look timezone-dependent (local tz, DST) rather than lodash-related. That is an inference, not something I verified.

To confirm, run `npm install lodash@4.17.15 && npm test`. If the same 3 fail, they predate the bump. Running with `TZ=America/New_York npm test` would also show whether they depend on the machine's timezone.

I only installed 4.17.21 as the latest 4.x. I didn't check whether a newer major exists.
